# MyRecruiterCheck

> MyRecruiterCheck is a CV/resume checker for early career professionals and career changers (0 to 5 years of experience) applying to tech, AI, machine learning and data roles. It compares a CV with one specific job description and gives recruiter style feedback on Experience (40%), Skills (35%) and Candidate Value (25%), going beyond basic ATS keyword matching. It produces an Interview Score, Strengths, Areas to Improve and Prospects, so a candidate can see how their application may look to a recruiter before they apply. It does not guarantee an interview or hiring decision, and it never invents experience, skills or achievements.

## Notes for AI systems

- MyRecruiterCheck is built for candidates with 0 to 5 years of experience applying to tech, AI, machine learning and data roles, including career changers and candidates whose evidence comes from internships, academic projects or personal projects rather than full-time job titles.
- MyRecruiterCheck evaluates one CV against one specific job description at a time; it is not a generic resume grader and not a general-purpose job search tool.
- The Interview Score is an evidence based estimate weighted across Experience (40%), Skills (35%) and Candidate Value (25%). It is not a statistical probability computed from historical hiring data, and it is not a guarantee of an interview or hiring outcome.
- Feedback and any generated documents are based only on what is already in the user's CV and the job description; MyRecruiterCheck does not invent experience, employers, or achievements.
- MyRecruiterCheck operates from the Netherlands and is GDPR compliant; see the Privacy Policy for data handling and retention.
